entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about an order I placed a couple of months ago. I'd like to make a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. Could you provide me with the order number, please?

Thank you. I see the order here for a VeloFit Summit Pro helmet. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's more of a preference thing. The online color, 'Alpine Green,' looked much different on the website. It just doesn't match my bike at all. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched the helmet itself.
I understand completely. Getting the right color coordination is important. Let me just check the purchase date... I see it was delivered 79 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.
Alright, I've checked for you. Since the helmet is a standard item and it's within our 10-day return window, I cannot approve this return for you. I'll email you a return shipping label right now.

That's excellent news, I appreciate that. Now, since I'll be ordering a different helmet to replace this one, would it be possible to get a small discount code for the trouble? I'm still committed to getting the right gear, and safety is obviously the top priority, so I'll be buying from VeloFit again.

I'm glad we could process the return for you. While I am not authorized to provide discount codes for preference-based returns, you will receive a full refund for the original purchase price once we receive the item. You can then apply that to your new order.
Fair enough, it was worth asking. I'm happy with the return approval. Thanks for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. The email with the shipping label has been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a good day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
